space.place: small cozy cafe on a rainy city street at night
space.ambient: Gentle ambient life: rain sparkles past the window, candle flames flicker softly and thin steam rises from the coffee cups
space.continuity: the two characters' faces, hair and outfits, the walls, front window, glass door, counter, espresso machine, shelves, pendant lamps, flowers, candles and lighting

shotMeta.subject: the glass door of the cafe, with the young man stepping in from the rainy street
shotMeta.action: The man in the long charcoal coat pushes the glass door open and steps inside from the rain. Behind the counter, the barista looks up toward the door.

shotMeta.subject: the man walking to the counter and sitting down on a bar stool
shotMeta.action: The man walks across the cafe to the counter, pulls out a bar stool and sits down facing the barista. Rain glitters past the front window.

shotMeta.subject: the man seated at the counter, ordering from the barista across the counter
shotMeta.action: The seated man looks up and speaks to order an espresso. The barista leans in slightly, listening with a gentle smile, and nods.

shotMeta.subject: the barista stepping over to the chrome espresso machine at the end of the counter
shotMeta.action: The barista smiles, turns and walks to the espresso machine. She takes the portafilter from the group head and knocks out the old coffee grounds.

shotMeta.subject: the barista at the espresso machine grinding and tamping the coffee
shotMeta.action: She holds the portafilter under the grinder and fresh ground coffee falls into it, then she presses the coffee flat with the tamper.

shotMeta.subject: the barista's hands at the espresso machine, seen from her side
shotMeta.action: She locks the portafilter into the group head with a firm twist and sets a small white cup under the spouts.

shotMeta.subject: close-up of dark espresso pouring from the machine's spouts into a small white cup
shotMeta.action: She presses the button. Two thin streams of dark espresso with golden crema pour slowly into the white cup and soft steam rises in the warm light.

shotMeta.subject: the barista at the espresso machine turning toward the man seated at the counter
shotMeta.action: While the espresso finishes pouring, she turns her head and gives the man a soft, shy smile. He smiles back from his stool, rain glittering in the window behind him.

scene.desc: A small, cozy cafe on a city street on a rainy night. Warm dark-wood walls, counter and shelves; a large front window and a glass door looking out on the wet street with glowing street lamps and falling rain. Glass-dome pendant lamps hang over the counter, wooden shelves behind hold glass jars of coffee beans and white porcelain cups, and a chrome espresso machine sits on the counter. Pastel pink and white flowers, small candles in glass holders and croissants under a glass cloche decorate the counter, and two bar stools stand in front of it. The female lead is the barista: a young woman with long, voluminous wavy chestnut-brown hair decorated with small white flower ornaments, dangling crystal earrings, a cream ribbed-knit blouse with lace cuffs and a taupe-brown apron with leather straps. The male lead is a tall young man with neat dark hair in a long charcoal wool coat over a white shirt.
